title: Nexus ReadingAnnotation
description: Shared annotation detail object returned by POST, PATCH, and as list items in GET /v1/daemon/reading/annotations. Represents a single persistent highlight with optional note, anchored by character offsets into the chapter body plain text.

start_offset.description: Character offset where the highlight begins (inclusive).

end_offset.description: Character offset where the highlight ends (exclusive). Guaranteed > start_offset.

selected_text.description: The highlighted body text captured at creation time.

color.description: Highlight color. V1.89 enum: {yellow, blue, green, pink}.

note.description: Optional free-text note. Absent or null when no note has been set.
